profile.belief: I am a multi-passionate with faith in the continuing impact made by creatives. With a strong desire to connect and be among the world's leading inspirators, I take to my camera, pen, and paint to develop my means of communication and contribute to this ever-evolving space. In growing my experiences–from volunteering at Sundance Film Festival to interning in music A&R–I understand the power of a creative community and would love to share in it with you!
profile.working_on: Through creative direction, development, or management, I hope to contribute to the production of untold narratives.
